reason: $147 a month is three or four times what the other DM tools charge, and I already paid for a cheap one that got me an action block and almost no replies. I'm not putting a card down on something with zero published results at that price.
objection: Nobody has shown me it works. No customer results, 7 seats sold, and the last tool that said it was 'human pace' got my account blocked. Plus a card up front and no refunds after day 3.
would_change_my_mind: A real setter or agency owner showing their own reply and booked-call numbers over a few weeks with no action block, and a price closer to $60-70 a month, or a trial without a card.
